name: Valhalla Chronicles
source:
Gods do not only exist in ancient times, today, it is believed that they are still very close to us. We put ourselves in the shoes of a struggling father, without a job, without confidence, with a rebellious daughter and a wife who helps us whenever she can. We will have to gain more self-confidence and face things we would never believe. We will also face many people who only want to see us fail. But as someone once said, "Don't try, just do it."

[From F95 ZONE]
translation:
神不仅存在于远古时代，今天，人们相信他们仍然离我们很近。我们把自己想象成一个苦苦挣扎的父亲，没有工作，没有信心，有一个叛逆的女儿和一个尽可能帮助我们的妻子。我们必须获得更多的自信，面对我们永远不相信的事情。我们还将面对很多只想看到我们失败的人。但正如有人曾经说过的，“不要尝试，只管去做”。

[来自F95区]
